en: Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographic views of grand historic buildings, decorated with floral motifs and overlaid with dense handwritten script. The left image shows a large neo‑Renaissance opera house on a busy square with carriages and people (the Vienna State Opera). The right image shows a curved, ornate theater building with columns and statues (the Burgtheater). Printed captions in German identify the city as Wien and the buildings as imperial theaters. There is a handwritten date in the early 1900s on the right side and extensive cursive correspondence across the lower half.
